beats.text: In Madagascar, the gap between bank loan and deposit interest rates is a staggering 47.9%.
It is the interest rate charged by banks on loans minus the rate paid for deposits.
Madagascar holds the world highest spread. That is 17 times the 2.9% found in China.
Brazil is also high, with a gap of 32.5%.
Russia has a much tighter gap at 2.5%, while Qatar sits at 0.1%.
New Zealand is the lowest of all, down 3.9%.
How wide is the gap between loan and deposit rates in your home country?
